responsibility: This is the central abstract-syntax-tree and declaration database implementation for the mc front end in mc-boot. It owns the concrete node kinds and records for modules, types, expressions, statements, comments, scopes, and fixups; provides the large family of constructors, predicates, lookup and scope-management routines, AST duplication helpers, and semantic attributes; tracks the main/current module and language mode; and finally walks the built tree to emit translated output through mcPretty in C, C++, or Modula-2 form, making it the core IR and code-emission hub beneath passes mcp1-mcp5.
same_name_distinction: Implements the declaration/AST API declared in Gdecl.h: it defines the concrete node records, storage, constructors, scope and lookup machinery, duplication helpers, language selection, and the final tree walk that emits output. Unlike the header, it is the private implementation and code-generation body for decl.
